description: This file defines functions and classes for building and managing database queries for a table chart in the Superset frontend, including query mode inference, query construction with various options, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getQueryMode
methods.description: Infers the query mode (raw or aggregate) based on form data, prioritizing explicit mode or presence of all_columns.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query object based on form data and options, handling metrics, sorting, time comparisons, post-processing, pagination, and additional queries for totals and percentages.

methods.name: cachedBuildQuery
methods.description: Creates a cached version of the buildQuery function to optimize repeated query building with external filter caching.
